purpose: Disambiguate the monotonic 0xFFFF8014/0xFFDCC0 candidate from a spatial track-position value.
address_width_note: The 68010 listing spells the absolute-short address as 0xFFFF8014; the installed MAME program space exposes the 24-bit bus address 0xFF8014.
static_instruction: 0x0222DE: addq.l #1,$8014.w; the handler returns with RTE at 0x0222F2
conclusion: 0xFFFF8014 is an interrupt-driven global tick, not a proven track-position accumulator. Its copies and shifted forms remain timing inputs to road, geometry, and object paths.
